title: Digital Marketing and Website Executive
description:
Digital Marketing and SEO/ Website Executive

Crowborough, East Sussex

Up to 40,000 per annum + Profit and Performance Related Annual Bonus

Hours - Monday - Friday 9-5pm/8.30am-4.30pm. 35hours. Office Based. 1 day hybrid to be discussed following probation.

Benefits: Generous Holiday Allowance, Private Medical, Pension, Parking, Life Assurance, Social and Team events.

Are you passionate about digital marketing and website management? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment? If so, our client, a leading organisation is looking for a talented Digital Marketing and Website Executive to join their vibrant team in Crowborough!

What You'll Do:

As the Digital Marketing and Website Executive, you will take charge of the day-to-day management, performance, and enhancement of the organisation's digital presence.

Your responsibilities will include:

Website Management:
- Oversee daily updates to ensure website content is accurate, current, and aligned with brand messaging.
- Build, edit, and maintain website pages using WordPress and Elementor.
- Create and update campaign landing pages, product pages, sector pages, and more.
- Maintain website structure, internal links, menus, forms, and calls to action.
- Collaborate with external developers for technical improvements as needed.
- Ensure a seamless user experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

SEO & Website Performance:
- Support the execution of SEO strategies that align with marketing objectives.
- Conduct keyword research and optimise website elements for better visibility.
- Monitor website performance using tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Google Search Console.
- Identify opportunities to enhance organic visibility, user engagement, and conversions.
- Perform regular SEO housekeeping to maintain optimal performance.

Digital Content & Campaign Support:
- Create engaging and SEO-informed content for the website and blogs.
- Collaborate with subject matter experts to translate technical information into user-friendly content.
- Utilise AI tools responsibly for content planning and optimisation.
- Work alongside the Marketing Manager to develop digital destinations for campaigns.

Collaboration & Contribution:
- Partner with colleagues across Marketing, Sales, and Technical teams to ensure accuracy in digital activities.
- Contribute innovative ideas to enhance website performance and customer journeys.

What We're Looking For:
- 3-5 years in a digital marketing, website/SEO role.
- Strong hands-on experience with WordPress and website management.
- Excellent writing and editing skills for creating clear and engaging content.
- Good grasp of on-page and technical SEO principles.
- Familiarity with SEO platforms like SEMrush and analytics tools like Google Analytics.
- Understanding of ecommerce / Marketing principles is a plus.
- Basic knowledge of HTML and CSS is desirable.
- Strong attention to detail and a practical, organised approach.

Haywards Heath

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing & Communications Executive
- Location: Burgess Hill, Head Office
- Job Type: Full-time, 40 hours per week
- Working Pattern: Office-based
- Salary: £32,000

We're currently supporting a client in their search for a Marketing & Communications Executive to join their growing team. Working closely with senior leadership, this position plays a key role in delivering marketing initiatives and supporting wider business growth.

The successful candidate will be involved in creating engaging content, managing digital marketing activities, and supporting commercial objectives through effective communication, creative campaigns, and brand-focused marketing efforts. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their marketing career within a collaborative and fast-paced environment.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Support the delivery of the marketing strategy, ensuring consistent branding and tone of voice across all communications.
- Manage and create content for social media channels, keeping the website content fresh and optimised for SEO.
- Develop written, visual, and video content for digital channels, newsletters, case studies, and customer communications.
- Create and adapt marketing and sales collateral using Adobe Creative Suite.
- Support exhibitions, events, and sales activities with relevant communications and marketing materials.
- Maintain marketing activity calendars and assist with updates to the eCommerce site.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
McBride Sport is delighted to be partnering with one of the UK's leading sports, entertainment, and leisure organisations to appoint a Marketing Manager. The group operates a portfolio of high-profile venues across the country. Each one stages live sporting action throughout the year alongside a busy calendar of concerts, conferences, hospitality, and private events. This is a chance to take the lead on marketing across a number of venues in the South and South-East. You'll shape and deliver the marketing vision, creating bold, revenue-generating campaigns that make a real commercial impact. That means driving ticket sales, hospitality and corporate bookings, and income from non-event-day activity, while raising the profile of every venue in the region.

Day to day, you'll turn central and local strategy into campaigns that perform. You'll plan and book media, brief internal designers from concept through to delivery, and create engaging written, video and photo content for websites, email and social channels. You'll also work with the group's SEO and social media specialists to optimise digital performance, manage online reputation and customer feedback, and use campaign analysis to keep improving results. You'll line-manage the regional marketing team and own the regional budget, so a blend of creative thinking and sharp commercial focus is essential. What we're looking for:
- A strong B2 C background, ideally within leisure, hospitality, sport or live events
- Hands-on experience across on- and offline campaigns, social media, CRM and CMS platforms
- At least four years' experience in a similar marketing role, with line management and budget responsibility
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the organisation to deliver under pressure

You'll be a creative, results-driven self-starter who enjoys the pace of a live events environment. Previous experience in the events or leisure (B2 C) industry, and a marketing qualification would be an advantage. If you're ready to make your mark in an exciting and fast-moving industry, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Marketing Manager
description:

- Drive brand awareness, customer engagement and lead generation activities

- Own brand messaging, positioning and creative consistency across all customer touchpoints
- Monitor campaign performance, analyse results and optimise activity to maximise ROI
- Manage marketing budgets and ensure effective allocation of spend
- Oversee website content and customer journey improvements to enhance performance

Profile

- Strong campaign planning and execution skills
- Commercially minded with budget and ROI experience
- Skilled in stakeholder and agency management
- Confident using data and insights to drive decisions
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Highly organised and able to manage multiple projects
- Experience within retail, ecommerce or consumer brands

title: Senior Digital Marketing Executive - PPC & Analytics
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Digital Marketing Executive to join a growing digital agency, managing paid media campaigns and performance tracking across a varied portfolio of SME clients.

This is a delivery-focused role with a particular emphasis on Google Search Ads and conversion tracking. You'll take ownership of existing client accounts, manage and optimise campaigns, and ensure the tracking behind them is set up accurately.

You'll also work across Meta Ads and wider digital marketing activity, collaborating with SEO, content and web development colleagues.

Key responsibilities
- Manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns, with a strong focus on Search.
- Audit existing PPC accounts and identify opportunities to improve performance.
- Manage keywords, search terms, negative keywords, bidding strategies, budgets and ad copy.
- Monitor campaign performance against CPA, conversions, ROAS and wider client objectives.
- Set up and manage conversion tracking using Google Tag Manager and GA4.
- Configure tags, triggers, events and conversions across client websites and campaigns.
- Troubleshoot tracking issues and ensure conversion data is accurate and reliable.
- Manage and optimise Meta Ads campaigns.
- Produce clear performance reporting and translate data into practical recommendations for clients.
- Support landing-page optimisation, CRO and A/B testing.
- Work directly with clients to discuss campaign performance, strategy and improvements.
- Collaborate with SEO, content and web development teams across wider client projects.

What we're looking for
- Strong hands-on experience managing Google Ads/Search campaigns.
- Practical experience with Google Tag Manager and GA4, including setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking.
- Experience managing paid media budgets and optimising against commercial KPIs.
- Hands-on Meta Ads experience.
- Good understanding of digital analytics, attribution and conversion measurement.
- Comfortable managing multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn performance data into recommendations.
- Confident communicating directly with clients.
- Agency or multi-client experience would be particularly beneficial.

Desirable experience
- Looker Studio/reporting dashboards.
- SEO and content optimisation.
- CRO and landing-page optimisation.
- Google Shopping, Performance Max, Display or Merchant Centre.
- Ecommerce campaigns.
- Marketing automation and AI tools.

This would suit someone who enjoys being hands-on with campaigns and data, rather than moving away from delivery into pure strategy or management. You'll have autonomy over your accounts and the opportunity to work across a varied client base while continuing to develop your wider digital marketing expertise.

title: Senior Marketing Executive

title: Senior Marketing Executive
company: The Caravan and Motorhome Club - Agency - Contract
description:
Senior Marketing Executive (12-Month Fixed Term Contract)
Salary: 33,000 to 35,000
Location: East Grinstead, RH19 1 UA (Hybrid - 1-2 days in the office)
Working pattern: 35 hours per week, Monday to Friday.
About the Club
The Caravan and Motorhome Club gives more than one million members access to nearly 2,700 places to stay across the UK and Europe. Alongside that choice of locations, the Club shares its knowledge and expertise to help members get the most out of caravanning and motorhoming.
The role
This is a 12-month fixed term contract for a CRM-focused Senior Marketing Executive to deliver multi-channel campaigns for the Club's UK and Overseas accommodation. You will report to the UK and Overseas Marketing Manager and work with product managers, the wider marketing team and external agencies.
You will help develop and put into practice the Club's CRM strategy. That means identifying key member segments and finding chances for personalised communication that increase member engagement and help hit bookings targets. There are no direct reports.
What you'll be doing
- Managing campaigns from brief to reporting across CRM, email, e-newsletter, the Club magazine, app push notifications and SMS, covering content, segmentation and deployment
- Working with Marketing Managers and product owners to agree priorities and recommend ways to improve marketing performance
- Creating marketing communication plans and working with channel owners to keep them on track and on deadline
- Writing and presenting marketing briefs for internal teams and external agencies
- Tracking campaign performance against agreed KPIs and recommending changes for future activity
- Working with the Club's CRM agency to segment and target the member database with personalised, relevant messages
- Creating content across all channels, including copywriting and sourcing images
- Proofreading communications and checking details with product teams so everything is accurate
- Supporting budget management, including processing POs and invoices on time and recording spend accurately
- Making sure all activity follows brand guidelines and meets legal and regulatory requirements, including DPA, GDPR, PECR and ASA
- Contributing to market research and competitor analysis
- Helping with ad-hoc marketing projects in line with team priorities

What you'll bring
- A degree in a related subject, or equivalent practical marketing or CRM experience
- At least 3 years' experience delivering multi-channel B2 C marketing campaigns, with a strong focus on CRM
- Experience running campaigns across a range of digital channels
- The ability to manage several campaigns at once, prioritise well and meet deadlines
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience managing stakeholders
- Commercial awareness and confidence with numbers, with the ability to interpret data and turn it into clear actions
- A well-organised approach, comfortable working independently and as part of a team
- Excellent copywriting skills and close attention to detail
- Ideally, some experience of the UK and overseas travel markets
- An interest in the outdoors, caravanning or motorhoming is welcome but not essential

Additional information
The Caravan and Motorhome Club is committed to building a diverse workforce. All applications are treated equally, and we recruit purely on skills and experience. Our people are our greatest strength, so we celebrate differences and work to create an environment where colleagues feel respected and valued for what they bring.

title: SEO Manager
description:
KRG are working with a long established and highly respected integrated marketing agency in Brighton who are on the search for an SEO Manager to join their growing team. They work on integrated campaigns for a range of local and UK clients using their specialists across SEO, content, social media, paid media, web design and analytics.

The team has been expanding over the past few months as the agency has had a increase of inbound leads with new clients and they value ensuring that none of the team have a workload which is too much, so they're looking to hire another Manager to own some of their growing client accounts!

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and execute SEO strategies tailored to clients' goals and target audiences.
- Conduct keyword research to identify opportunities for content and technical optimisation.
- Perform SEO audits of client websites to assess performance, uncover issues, and recommend improvements.
- Manage on-page SEO including meta tags, internal linking, URL structure, content optimisation, and schema markup.
- Oversee technical SEO such as site speed, mobile-friendliness, crawlability, indexing, and structured data.
- Collaborate with content teams to guide the creation of SEO-optimised content (blogs, landing pages, etc.).
- Monitor and analyse SEO performance using tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, etc.
- Generate reports that clearly communicate SEO progress, KPIs, and ROI to clients.
- Stay up to date with industry trends, algorithm updates, and best practices.
- Coordinate with web developers to implement technical changes and enhancements.
- Communicate with clients regularly to provide updates, present results, and refine strategy.
- Support junior team members, ensuring best practices are followed across client accounts.
- Maintain project timelines and budgets while ensuring deliverables meet quality standards.

About You:
- Agency side SEO experience at a Senior Executive or Manager level - or equivalent.
- Good organisation and time management skills.
- Analytical mind and problem-solving skills.
- Great written skills.
- Proficiency in Google Docs, Sheets and Slides.
- Understanding of CSS and HTML.
- Basic understanding/interest in AI.

What can they offer you?
- The agency is focusing on expanding their already established SEO team with three new hires in the past 6 months - everybody across the agency sees the value in SEO and wants the team to do well!
- A vibrant and creative environment in the heart of Brighton.
- 28 days holiday, plus bank holidays.
- Christmas office closure.
- Hybrid working model.
- Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and sick pay
- Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) supporting health and wellbeing
- Scottish Widows pension
- Personal Development Plan with biannual reviews and objective setting
- Annual pay review
- Unparalleled training and development opportunities.
- Regular employee training sessions and team-building activities
- Referral Bonus for introducing new employees
- Regular company socials
- Christmas and Summer company parties
- Amazon voucher on your birthday
- Local artisan coffee, weekly fruit delivery, cakes and treats
- Modern and creative office space with break-out areas, including pool, ping pong table and darts.
